paper.authors: Paladini, Baron, Jorissen, Le Bouquin, Freytag, Van Eck, Wittkowski, Hron, Chiavassa, Berger, Siopis, Mayer, Sadowski, Kravchenko, Shetye, Kerschbaum, Kluska, Ramstedt

publication_status.evidence: Nature page https://www.nature.com/articles/nature25001 (Letter, published 20 Dec 2017, vol 553, pp 310-312) and Crossref doi 10.1038/nature25001. Full text is paywalled; numerical values below come from the ESO-hosted author manuscript https://elt.eso.org/public/archives/releases/sciencepapers/eso1741/eso1741a.pdf (title 'Convective pattern on the surface of the giant star pi1 Gruis', 8 pages), which may differ in small details from the final Nature text. No arXiv version found. bibcode not verified, left null.

method: PIONIER (4 ATs, H band, 3 spectral channels) at VLTI, nights 2014 Sep 25 and 29. Model-independent images via SQUEEZE (MCMC regularized ML) and MiRA, channel by channel. UD diameter fitted to visibilities with LitPro. Granule size from power spectral density of images (square-masked 24x24 px region); contrast = dI_rms/<I> after limb-darkening correction. (Main text pp.1-2; Methods pp.5-6 of manuscript.)
uncertainties: Contrast errors are statistical only: standard deviation over the SQUEEZE MCMC images; the text states systematic errors (seeing, limited resolution) are difficult to assess and expected to lower the observed contrast (p.2). Data carry an added 5% systematic relative uncertainty (Methods, Data, p.5). Granule size error = standard deviation of the three channel PSD peaks.

conventions.data: 303 spectrally dispersed visibilities and 201 closure phases
conventions.reduction: pndrs, calibrated data average of 5 consecutive files per OB, 5% systematic relative uncertainty added
conventions.stellar_params_MARCS: Teff=3200 K, log g=-0.44 (text elsewhere writes -0.4), solar metallicity, [s/Fe]=+1, C/O=0.991; literature Teff 3100 K, L 7200 Lsun, M 1.5 Msun

image.code: SQUEEZE (primary; Baron et al. 2010) and MiRA (Thiebaut 2008)
image.regulariser: SQUEEZE: spot regulariser + l0 sparsity in image plane (chosen by simulation on spotless/spotted LD discs with OIFITS-SIM); channel-by-channel (polychromatic with total-variation trans-spectral regulariser tried, no major difference). MiRA: smoothness regulariser, no prior image; hyperparameter mu from L-curve.
image.fov_note: 64x64 pixels at 0.45 mas/pixel (computed 64*0.45 = 28.8 mas; FOV not quoted directly)
image.chi2: reduced chi2 ~1.3 for final SQUEEZE image
image.procedure: 50 parallel simulated-annealing MCMC chains at 16x16 (1.8 mas/px), then 32x32 (0.9 mas/px) initialised from the mean, then 64x64 (0.45 mas/px); final image = mean over 64x64 chains
figures: Fig. 1 (SQUEEZE a-c, MiRA a'-c' images, three channels)
Extended Data Fig. 1 (data, uv coverage, FT of image)
Extended Data Fig. 2 (mean +-1 sigma SQUEEZE images)

notes: Limb-darkening law: no parametric LD law fitted; diameter is a UD fit, justified because MARCS intensity profiles are close to a UD in the first visibility lobe (Methods p.6). Number of cells: NOT given in the manuscript (null); only characteristic size and contrast. MiRA chi2 not given. SQUEEZE reduced chi2 ~1.3 is the only chi2 quoted. Limb-darkened-disc profile used for contrast correction is not specified numerically. Page numbers refer to the ESO manuscript PDF, not Nature pages. Data statement: reduced PIONIER data in oidb.jmmc.fr. The ESO manuscript text title differs from the published title.
